d: Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ke char divsiy anushthan ke dusre din aaj vrati kharna ka pujan karenge. sham ko kharna ka prasad grahan karne ke bad vrati 36 ghante ka nirjala upvas shuru karenge, jo chhath mahaparv ke samapan tak jari rahega. is avsar par puja samagri ki kharidari ke lie bajaron men logon ki bhari bhir umar rahi hai. vahin, bal divas ke avsar par rashtrapti draupdi murmu bachchon, abhibhavkon aur shikshakon se mulakat karengi. mukhyamantri ne bhi bal divas ki shubhkamnaen dete hue kaha ki rajy sarkar ka pramukh lakshy pratyek bachche ko gunvattapurn shiksha uplabdh karana…
